column1: # scripts/release/repos.tsv: every artifact a HugMesh org release publishes (beta and
# stable), read by scripts/release.sh (docs/RELEASING.md). One row per repository:
# stage    dependency order. 1-4 the Maven chain (build-config -> parent -> commons ->
#          auth-core), 5 the gateway base image, 6 its be/fe/pki overlays (FROM the
#          gateway image), 7 the Java BFF/API images, 8 the Angular UIs, 9 games,
#          forum-api and the mesh-node image. scripts/release-beta.sh holds which stage
# kind     mvn = Maven library on GitHub Packages; img = container image(s) on GHCR.
# version  the file on main that carries the version; the release is <tag prefix><that
#          version>. NO VERSION NUMBERS BELONG IN THIS FILE: bump the repo's own version
#          file in a PR and the next run picks it up.
# packages space-separated package names (GHCR image names without ghcr.io/hugmesh/,
# mirrors  optional, comma-separated: what a STABLE version bump moves besides the version
#          file (the bump PR into release/X.Y, and main's next-beta PR). A path names
#          another version file (a package.json also moves its package-lock.json);
#          <file>:Version is a "**Version X.Y.Z**" line; <file>:heading is a new
#          "## X.Y.Z" changelog heading (stable only, prose left to a human);
#          gateway-pin is the PINNED_GATEWAY_IMAGE / GATEWAY_IMAGE_PIN in the workflow.
#          Every pom's own version, <parent>, net.hugmesh dependencies and
#          <hugmesh-*.version> properties move without being listed here.
